messages:
Maya (Design): Quick sync: support asked that trace export and copy ID be reachable without a popover. They lose context when a modal appears.
Ken (Eng Runtime): Popover breaks keyboard flow indeed. Current pattern: icon group -> split export. We can move Copy ID into primary slot and make export a mild dropdown.
Aria (Product): Users told us they want one-click copy while inspecting spans, export only when saving. So emphasise copy first.
Raj (SRE): Also need an inline size hint for export options. Full snapshot often fails if too big. Showing estimate helps triage.
Noah (Accessibility): A11y notes: Copy button must announce "copied" via live region. Dropdown must be operable with arrow keys and have clear aria-labels.
Maya (Design): Proposed layout: [Copy trace ID pill] [Share icon] [Export ⋁]. Export opens menu with small text-estimates and a secondary "Download" CTA.
Ken (Eng Runtime): Implementation: DOM order = Copy, Share, Export. Export menu uses role=menu with menuitems. Add aria-live for copy.
Aria (Product): Microcopy: pill = "Copy trace ID"; export options: "Download JSON (≈12MB)", "Download sanitized JSON (≈1MB)", "Download full snapshot (may include sensitive data)".
Raj (SRE): For full snapshot require a confirmation checkbox and rate-limit exports per-project. Server returns size estimate before download.
Noah (Accessibility): Modal must trap focus, use role=dialog, and announce the PII warning as alert. Tooltips on icons must be keyboard-visible.
ci-bot: ci: test job queued for trace-toolbar-change by Ken at 2025-04-02T14:10:00Z
Maya (Design): I'll upload small comps and contrast tokens. Can we get an experiment flagged rollout to test discoverability?
Ken (Eng Runtime): Will add flag trace_toolbar_reflow, default 5% ramp. I'll instrument copy_click, export_open, export_confirm, export_error.
Aria (Product): Thanks — prefer gradual rollout + support checklist. I'll coordinate docs and support blurb.
Maya (Design): Great work team — follow-up thread with Figma link soon :sparkles:
